info.name: CEC Electronic - Full API
info.description:
Covers every route in routes/web.php: storefront browsing, cart, checkout, customer auth/account, and full admin CRUD (products, categories, orders, customers, suppliers, delivery zones).

How CSRF is handled: this app's CSRF middleware (Illuminate\Foundation\Http\Middleware\PreventRequestForgery) skips token verification whenever the request's `Sec-Fetch-Site` header says `same-origin` -- real browsers set this automatically on same-origin requests and page JS cannot override it, so it's a valid signal there. Every request in this collection sets that header directly, which is why plain JSON bodies work everywhere with no hidden `_token` field or XSRF cookie dance needed.

Run order matters: this collection uses ONE shared session/cookie jar. Run folders top to bottom in the Collection Runner (Bootstrap -> Customer Auth -> Customer Account -> Storefront -> Cart -> Checkout -> Admin Auth -> Admin *). Logging in as Admin replaces the Customer session (same `users` table / same guard), so Customer-only requests must run before Admin Login.
